card.name: Start of 'rate' or 'ratio' words
card.fires_on: The letter r (or -r) that begins a word such as rates, rapid, ratio or radiation, usually split off from the rest of the word. It is most common in all-caps headings and in hyphenated terms like fixed-ratio.

modes.label: Capital R in headings
modes.description: A lone R starting a word in an all-caps section heading or warning.
modes.example: DILUTIONS AND<< R>>ATES FOR INTRAVENOUS INF

modes.label: Hyphen then r
modes.description: The -r that begins ratio inside a hyphenated term.
modes.example: For patients on a regimen of fixed<<-r>>atio opioid/non-opioid analges

card.writes: It seems to suppress the 'route/routing' continuation, which would otherwise be promoted after an r start.
card.plain: It marks the opening letter of words like rate, rapid or ratio when they are split apart in headings or hyphenated terms.
